data.name: Elemental Focus
data.description: The water master can prepare one additional spell per day of each level she can cast, but it must have the water descriptor. Preparing a fire spell takes up two spell slots of the same level. You take a -4 penalty on any skill checks made when crafting a magic item that has a fire spell as a prerequisite.
